Add(IServiceCollection, RegistrationType, Func<TypeInfo, bool>, IEnumerable<Assembly>, Assembly, bool)

Adds registration to the IOC by using a type filter. Abstract types and Interfaces are automatically filtered out for implementation. A good way is to use the filter in combination with 'IsOfType', then all types based on that type will be found.

public static void Add(this IServiceCollection services, RegistrationType registrationType, Func<TypeInfo, bool> filter, IEnumerable<Assembly> assemblies = null, Assembly baseAssembly = null, bool findInterface = true)

Parameters

services IServiceCollection
registrationType RegistrationType

Type of registration as Transient, Scoped or Singleton.

filter Func<TypeInfo, bool>

The actual type filter. Ex. x => x.IsOfType(typeof(MyService))

assemblies IEnumerable<Assembly>

An optional list of assemblies of where to look for types. If not provided the baseAssembly, or default will be used.

baseAssembly Assembly

Provide a base assembly of where to start looking for types. By default, EntryAssembly or ExecutingAssembly will be used.

findInterface bool

If true, interface types will be automatically found based on a concrete type. If false, the concrete type is registered without an interface.
